name: claude-workbench
description: A personal, public collection of Claude Code plugins: model-split reminder, optional git-identity guard, continuous work without sessions, and a catalog that proposes them.

plugins.name: catalog
plugins.description: Compares the marketplace with what is installed and proposes what to install or update; connects the project and lists every plugin's options in one table.

plugins.name: model-protocol
plugins.description: Reminds Claude on every message to split work between Opus, Sonnet and Haiku (hook) and writes the full rule into CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: continuum
plugins.description: Continuous work without sessions: memory in an Obsidian vault (own MCP), log and commit by a hook without AI, reader and tester subagents.

plugins.name: git-identity
plugins.description: Optional guard for the emails you do not want in your commits: warns, blocks git commit/push and fixes the repo.
